title: 851. Exam Room

examples.explanation: Seats spread to ends then middle; freed 4 is retaken.

hints: Keep occupied seats in an ordered set; the best seat always lies at an end or midway between two neighbours.
For an interior gap (a,b) the candidate is (a+b)//2 with distance (b-a)//2; for edges use 0 or N-1 directly.
Scan all gaps per seat() call: with few operations this linear scan is simplest and fast enough.
